catalog.title: Parts
catalog.subtitle: Catalog of parts the workshop and the vans carry.
catalog.emptyBody: Add the parts you keep in stock so technicians can pick them on a job.

fields.name: Name
fields.minStockHint: The office is notified once a day when a location falls to this quantity or below.

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: Quantities per warehouse and van. Every change is a recorded movement.
stock.emptyBody: Record a stock entry to start counting parts in a location.
stock.noLocationsBody: Create a warehouse and one van per technician before recording stock.
stock.vanHint: A van belongs to one technician, who sees and uses only that van's stock.

movementHint.IN: Parts received into a location. The quantity is added.
movementHint.TRANSFER: Moves parts from one location to another, for example from the warehouse to a van.
movementHint.ADJUSTMENT: Corrects a count. Use a negative quantity to remove parts.

externalCost.title: External cost
externalCost.lockedHint: The external cost can be recorded once the job is completed.
externalCost.cancelledHint: This job was cancelled, so no external cost applies.
externalCost.rollUp: Included in the job total and in the machine cost.
